question: In March 2026, the Directorate General of Training has signed an MoU with ________ to train 1,000 youth in advanced manufacturing.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bajaj Auto Ltd.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Directorate General of Training (DGT), under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), signed a Flexible Memorandum of Understanding (Flexi-MoU) with Bajaj Auto Ltd.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Objective:** To provide industry-integrated training in advanced automotive manufacturing, including Electric Vehicles (EVs) and Robotics.
 
• **Target:** Bajaj Auto has committed to training **1,000 youth** in the initial year of the partnership.
 
• **Locations:** Training will be conducted at Bajaj's state-of-the-art facilities in **Maharashtra and Uttarakhand**.
 
• **Program Structure:** The training lasts up to 24 months and is aligned with the **National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF)**.
 
• **Industry Partner:** Under the June 2024 revised scheme, Bajaj Auto acts as an **Industry Training Partner (ITP)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Flexi-MoU Scheme__

 __
 
• A scheme by MSDE that allows industries to design and run customized training programs to meet their specific high-skill requirements.
 
 
 
• DGT (Directorate General of Training)__
 __
 
• The apex organization for development and coordination of programs relating to vocational training in India.
 
 
 
• Industry 4.0__
 
 
• Refers to the "Fourth Industrial Revolution," characterized by smart automation, data exchange, and the "Internet of Things" in manufacturing.
